name: truesight
description: TrueSight: virtual sensors you teach, evidence you can trust, privacy you can see.

scripts.dev: npm run build:verify && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @truesight/server" "wait-on --timeout 60000 tcp:127.0.0.1:8787 && npm run dev -w @truesight/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w truesight-verify && npm run build -w @truesight/server && npm run build -w @truesight/web
scripts.test: npm run build:verify && npm test -w truesight-verify && npm test -w @truesight/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:verify && npm run typecheck -w @truesight/server && npm run typecheck -w @truesight/web
